device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with CA card reader, CI slot, Ethernet and USB PVR

device.soc: ALi M3602B (bootloader "M3602B 1.1.6"; NIM_S3501_0, NIM_COFDM_0, DMX_S3601_0, DECV_AVC_0, DECV_S3601_0, OSD_S36_0/1, VPO_S3601; SDK4.0aa.5.17_SAB_S2_20130810)

source.author: Yumatu / Globo (Amstar GUI)
source.note: Archive amstar_yumatu_1.5.25_x4_newoldremote.zip from the Opticum / Opticum HD X402-X403-X4-X7 directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-01.

simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_yumatu_amstar_app_starts.py, run_dump_yumatu_amstar_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 / SDA = GPIO 171 using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (updating the 4-digit 7-segment display " ON " -> "    " -> " on "), prints "APP  init ok", unpacks maincode(AV) (6.73 MB) to 0x80008000, and starts the single-CPU application.  The application configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 ("---nim 3501 a-=[1]--type=[0x350100c0]----") and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, initialises hs_config_init over SPI, and without the board's anti-clone security IC renders its blue Turkish Amstar OSD dialog ("Cihazınız farklı,yazılım uymaz!") through GeM3602 (14 GE commands, 4 colours).

desc: Yumatu Full HD IQ / Opticum HD X4-series (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.5.25 with the Amstar GUI and dual (new + old) IR remote support (2013-08-10) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses the external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
